name: Kanvaz
summary:
Kanvaz is the the easiest way to create beautiful art in VR, effortlessly. 

You can make beautiful artworks in 10 minutes by following paint-by-number templates, no skills required.

Auto-correction system: your strokes snap perfectly into place - fast, effortless, and impossible to mess up
